The main takeaway from our work is that
large-scale knowledge graphs can be used to assist the generation of descriptions for images that contain visual objects unseen by the model during training.
knowledge graphs provide an effective way to expand the scope of visual concept detection, and to leverage the expanded knowledge for image description generation.
knowledge graphs are a valuable resource to assist image description generation, especially in domains that contain a significant number of visual objects unseen in training data.
